title: Jujutsu Kaisen Game Delayed to 2027: More Time for Cursed Chaos
summary:
Have you ever wished a game would take longer to come out—just so it could be even more awesome? Fans of Jujutsu Kaisen are about to find out. The new game, Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton, was supposed to arrive in 2026. But its latest trailer confirms it's been delayed to 2027. That's the same year the next season of the anime is expected. So maybe it's a double dose of Jujutsu Kaisen!

The game is being made by poncle, the studio behind the viral hit Vampire Survivors. That's a big deal. Vampire Survivors is famous for being impossible to put down. So this crossover could be just as addictive.

What's it like? It's a "survivors royale"—a mix of Vampire Survivors' power-up chaos and a battle royale where players get eliminated one by one. You battle cursed spirits, grow stronger, and try to be the last one standing. Up to eight people can play online, and there's a solo mode too.

The trailer shows playable characters like Yuji, Nobara, Megumi, Maki, Choso, Gojo, and Yuta—more than 20 fighters total. Bosses like Jogo, Geto, and Mahito can crash into the middle of a round. When you reach 100 points, you can add a new "rule" to mess with your rivals, just like in the anime's Culling Games arc.

So yes, the wait is longer. But hopefully that means poncle is cooking up something great. Gojo and friends will be back in the fray—on the Switch—before you know it.
why_it_matters: Delays happen with games, books, and even school projects — waiting so something can be done well can be worth it, and fans can use the extra time to catch up on the story.

background_read: Jujutsu Kaisen is a Japanese comic and anime (a cartoon series made in Japan) about a boy named Yuji Itadori who fights "cursed spirits" — scary monsters born from bad feelings.
Video games often get delayed, because makers need extra time to fix problems and make the game fun, even though waiting is hard for fans.
Vampire Survivors, made by the small game studio poncle, became a surprise hit because it is simple to learn but almost impossible to stop playing.
Article_Structure: WHO: The studio poncle (makers of Vampire Survivors) and fans of the Jujutsu Kaisen anime.
WHAT: The new game Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton was delayed from 2026 to 2027.
WHERE: The game is coming to the Switch, and the next anime season is expected in the same year.
WHY: More time should mean a better game — and it may arrive around the same time as the new anime season, giving fans a double dose.
